data.name: No Raised Hand
data.description: As long as you maintain psionic focus, anyone wanting to attack you must make a successful save (Will DC %1) or it can't follow through with the attack, that part of its action is lost, and they take a -1 morale penalty to all saving throws against powers manifested by you until the end of their next turn.  A creature that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to this effect for 24 hours.  Area effects are not subjected to this effect.  By spending your psionic focus as a move action, you can share this ability with all allies within 30 ft. for one round.|NoRaisedHandDC
